title: I Gave AI One Screenshot
script: I gave AI one screenshot, and asked it to build the interface. No design file. No component list. Just this image and a React project. The first attempt missed [VISIBLE_FIRST_PASS_MISTAKE]. You can see it here. I allowed one correction: [EXACT_CORRECTION]. This is the final result. [VERIFIED_VISUAL_AND_FUNCTIONAL_OBSERVATION]. Would you notice the difference?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Recreate a React interface from one image, then allow one correction pass.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: I gave AI one screenshot, and asked it to build the interface.
Can one screenshot become a working React page?
No design file. One image. One correction.
strongestHook: I gave AI one screenshot, and asked it to build the interface.
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: Recreate a React interface from one image, then allow one correction pass. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 15–60 minutes core build/test; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Create an original reference dashboard at 1440×900: sidebar, revenue summary, line chart, activity table and primary action. Freeze the screenshot and viewport. Prompt: Recreate this screenshot as a functional React page using the existing project. Save first output before giving one correction targeted at the largest observable error. Compare layout, typography, spacing and main-action behavior at the same viewport. Report observed mismatches rather than an invented similarity percentage.
evidenceRequirements: Capture source, first attempt and final output; note actual visual mistakes.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “One Screenshot Build” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
instagramCaption: I Gave AI One Screenshot. Recreate a React interface from one image, then allow one correction pass. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. Would you notice the difference?
tiktokCaption: I Gave AI One Screenshot. WOULD YOU NOTICE?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
assetBrief: Source screenshot, coding recording, first/final UI.
